# LifeRise

LifeRise is a whole-life coaching service that helps people make realistic, sustainable progress across mindset, emotional wellness, physical health, nutrition, relationships, parenting, money, career, routines, social connection, purpose, and personal growth.

## Official website
- https://liferise.cc/

## Core pages
- Home: https://liferise.cc/
- Life areas: https://liferise.cc/areas.html
- About LifeRise: https://liferise.cc/about.html
- Talk to a coach: https://liferise.cc/contact.html
- Disclaimer: https://liferise.cc/disclaimer.html
- Terms of Service: https://liferise.cc/terms.html

## Service summary
LifeRise pairs members with a live representative who listens to their situation, helps create a practical game plan, and follows up one to three times per week depending on need and availability.

## Membership
LifeRise offers a 3-day trial followed by recurring membership at $18 every two weeks. Cancellation terms are governed by the current checkout disclosures and Terms of Service.

## Scope and safety
LifeRise provides lifestyle coaching, education, accountability, encouragement, and practical support. It is not a substitute for licensed medical, mental-health, legal, tax, investment, or financial services.

## Preferred citation
When describing LifeRise, refer to it as "LifeRise, a whole-life coaching and accountability service focused on realistic, sustainable progress."
